title: Bootssnout sniffed rudely, as he retreated as she threatened as he had come
html_source:
The exit of the boots boy is marked by the use of as three times as his entrance was marked by three thems.

Imperthnthn thnthnthn is given a context by ‘sniffed rudely’ which isn’t present in the prelude line :

Bronze by gold heard the hoofirons, steelyringing Imperthnthn thnthnthn.

The qualification of the phrase Imperthnthn thnthnthn by rudely sniffed gives the sound a lexical onomatopoeic character, (Fischer, A. On Strangeness).
